concepts.def: Unfreeze, change, refreeze (Lewin 1947); foundational change management framework.
Establish urgency, build coalition, vision, communicate, empower, wins, consolidate, anchor (Kotter 1996).
Fear of loss, habit, distrust; Kotter & Schlesinger 1979 identified six causes and strategies.
New tech enters at low-end then climbs (Christensen 'The Innovator's Dilemma' 1997).
Coordinated response to sudden threats; Mitroff 5-stage model 1994; reputation often determined within 24 hours.
Move to iterative, customer-focused organisation; principles from Agile Manifesto 2001.
